summary: Phase-1 frontend validation PASSED. Fresh Firebase signup -> dev-bridge exchange (200) -> app redirects to /data-agent. New dark workspace shell at /v2 renders with all 6 sidebar nav items (Workspace, Incidents, Metrics, Enterprise Apps, Data Agent, Event Engine). /v2, /v2/incidents, /v2/metrics all render real content (NO blank/NotFound). /v2/incidents shows 'No active incidents' empty state after GET /api/v1/incidents/ returns 404 (acceptable per spec). /v2/metrics shows the P50/P90/P99 + Events/sec + Error Rate + Total Events tile grid after GET /api/v1/events/stats/ returns 404 (acceptable). Active nav item has a 3px electric-blue (rgb(77,139,255)) left-edge indicator; breadcrumbs update ('v2 / incidents'). Dark palette confirmed: [data-testid=app-layout] background = rgb(15,17,21) = #0F1115 (spec obsidian). FIX-03 logout verified: clicking sidebar-logout-button fires POST /api/v1/auth/logout/ 200 and sidebar user email flips to 'Not signed in' (backend JWT invalidated + client cleared). Regression: /apps/executive still renders (Executive dashboard content). Zero 401 responses across the full session (no auth loop).

integration_issues.issue: Persistent console error 'Failed to fetch credits: [SpaceForge] backend is not connected. Enterprise backend pending.' — credits service still bound to stub adapter (regression from iteration_1, not fixed).

action_items: OPTIONAL: data-testid naming inconsistency vs review-request spec. Spec named 'incidents-view-empty' / 'incidents-view-list' / 'metrics-view-grid' / 'metrics-view-empty'; code uses 'incidents-empty' / 'incidents-list' / 'metrics-grid' / 'metrics-empty'. Views themselves have correct 'incidents-view' and 'metrics-view' ids. Either rename inner ids to match spec or update the spec — functional PASS either way.

Still-open from iteration_1 (not part of this phase, informational): credits service using stub adapter, and duplicate tenant bootstrap POSTs on first signup (observed again: /organizations/ POST after GET; /workspaces/ POST after GET) — bootstrap now looks idempotent-ish (GET then POST when empty) rather than the previous double-POST; verify.
critical_code_review_comments: AppLayout hardcodes `className='dark'` and `--radius` inline — fine for /v2 isolation but note it forces dark regardless of ThemeProvider. Intentional per Phase-1 spec.
IncidentsView / MetricsView data-testid names differ from the review-request contract (see action_items). Only cosmetic.
useAuth.signOut now correctly calls platform.auth.logout() -> POST /api/v1/auth/logout/ before clearing local state; verified over network.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of Phase-1 acceptance items (FIX-02 routes, dark theme, FIX-03 logout+no-401-loop, /apps regression)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Signup selectors: Sign Up tab is the 2nd button matching 'Sign Up' text (avoid the header nav link). Placeholders: 'John Doe', 'you@example.com'. Two password inputs (password + confirm) — fill both. localStorage['onboarding-completed']='true' via add_init_script suppresses the tour on /v2 (but NOT the persona modal on /data-agent — irrelevant to /v2 tests). /v2 pages issue GET /api/v1/incidents/ and GET /api/v1/events/stats/ which currently 404 (expected Phase-1). Logout POST /api/v1/auth/logout/ returns 200 in Django lite. No 401 anywhere.
rca of the issue: N/A — all Phase-1 acceptance items pass. Non-blocking: (1) minor testid naming drift between spec and code; (2) credits stub still wired; (3) tenant bootstrap still emits GET+POST for both org and workspace on first signup (better than iteration_1 double-POST but worth confirming for idempotency).
